free_text: Decision to defer biopsy for a 66-year-old man with PI-RADS 3, PSA 7.68 ng/mL, PSA density 0.1 and a prior biopsy status of 'Negative'. The panel protocol settled it by the rule 'cohort criterion (pirads_le_3)' (EXPERT-COHORT); It matched the reading urologist in 16 of 18 labelled cases in exactly this situation (prior negative biopsy). The conference did not return a readable structured form, so this record was completed from the minute alone; no finding is asserted beyond the values in it.
